Use case: compositing / editorial opinion poster. Make ONE finished portrait 3:4 image, target1080x1440, for WeChat Moments. Image1 is TOPIC/LOGIC reference only; remove ALL its event promotion and completely redesign its illustration. Image2 is PRIMARY facial identity reference for Eli; preserve recognizable facial structure, hair and single silver glasses, natural skin. Image3 is STYLE reference only: white background, exceptionally bold black/purple typography and a large photographic cutout person. Do NOT include its numbers, words or Doubao girl.

Layout: sophisticated uncluttered editorial poster, pristine white with vivid purple and solid black. Top ~25% is very bold clean sans-serif Chinese headline in precisely TWO lines, safe generous margins: purple "大家都在用AI，" then black "公司却没怎么变？". Below it a medium bold secondary statement "一个人提效 ≠ 整家公司提效", using purple ≠. Central ~55% contains a single coherent sculptural workflow metaphor, not a grid of cards: two small stylized people working quickly at laptops on the left send small blank document sheets along one continuous purple path with clear directional arrows. These sheets pile up at two narrow handoff/decision gates, leaving the downstream path nearly empty. This must visually communicate individually fast work accumulating at organizational handoffs and decisions. Use clean matte white and purple dimensional objects, soft precise shadows, minimal graphic sophistication; no factory machinery, orange watercolor, handdrawn texture or glassmorphism. Three short problem labels positioned clearly along relevant points of the flow: "流程怎么改？" "谁来负责？" "谁来拍板？". Only these labels; do not add tiny explanatory words or AI labels on screens.
A large photographic Eli upper body occupies the right of the central composition, approximately40%width. Use identity from image2, brown blazer/white shirt acceptable, natural standing/leaning pose with ONE anatomically correct hand pointing towards the accumulation, unobstructed face and complete hair. Keep diagram large enough to understand, not swallowed by portrait. Ensure hand, arrows, text and face never collide; natural five-finger anatomy.
Bottom in clear white breathing room, bold closing statement "先打通流程，再谈AI提效"; below a small but readable signature "Eli｜AI落地实用经验".
Render ONLY the seven specified text units (headline two lines, secondary statement, three questions, closing statement, signature). Accurate simplified Chinese and punctuation. Everything legible at270px wide, strong hierarchy, no dense small print. No dates, conference, growth promises, event invitation, QR code, disclaimer, extra footer, watermark, brand mascot or numbers. Do not copy image1 visual scene. Natural face without etched texture, doubled glasses or eyebrows. White opaque background.
